title: Where the class has got to

steps.say: **Course Journey** is how far the class has travelled through its course. The bar is the share of the course the class has covered together.
The line under it gives the class average and how far it is to the next belt. That average is the honest number for planning a lesson.
The belt spread underneath tells you the other half: whether the class is holding together or pulling apart.
steps.terminal: That's where the class has got to — how far, and how tightly. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
